proof_obligations: Identify four disjoint sections and smooth proper projective rational-surface fibers.
Lift the quadratic pencil to L and prove effectivity.
Find exactly four pencil basepoints for nonzero t.
Check all four independent exceptional initial pairs.
Conclude nearby global generation and nefness.
Compute L squared zero and canonical intersection minus two.
Exclude all nearby adjoint sections including nowhere-vanishing sections.
Identify the central negative curve and A=2L minus that curve.
Check the four cubic common zeros and all simple/double exceptional initial generators.
Construct the smooth semipositive Fubini--Study metric on A.
Take the metric square root and obtain the analytic half-divisor coefficient.
Prove the selected nonzero conic is smooth rational and has degree zero.
Identify the two central components without extra exceptional components.
Check their unique transverse intersection and degree one on q.
Prove the conic surface submersion along q minus the node including its exceptional point.
Shrink the total-space neighborhood by properness.
Use the comparison to obtain genuine restrictions to the conic surface and q.
Apply local integrability and Fubini to obtain genuine restrictions to almost every nearby compact curve.
Use curvature positivity and degree zero to force nearby harmonic weights.
Justify zero tangential distributional Laplacian on each product chart.
Use finite psh disk averages, their canonical representatives and Harnack to force the central harmonic slice.
Identify the central restricted positive measure as the unit atom at the node.
Use the distributional logarithmic decomposition and transversality to contradict the half-divisor lower bound.
